name: 3D Gaussian Splitting via Moment Conservation
aliases: new split algorithm for 3D Gaussian splatting
definition: A method to decompose one $d$-dimensional Gaussian into two $d$-dimensional Gaussians to resolve scale and structural inhomogeneities, ensuring the resulting models are more uniform and surface-bounded.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splitting via Moment Conservation decomposes Gaussians using a closed-form solution that conserves statistical moments to resolve scale and structural inhomogeneities, unlike the original method's naive scaling and random translation.
